text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's rare.
Walnuts are on sale.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
In that case, maybe I'll make
some mamebu soup today for the first time in a while!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Knead the dango, then cut up the burdock root,
shimeji mushrooms, and carrots...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Nah, it's too much trouble to cook anything from scratch now...
I'll just buy some roasted green tea and make tea porridge...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Yukino Bijin still has lingering fatigue
from her race. It might be best to reconsider
her upcoming schedule.
